caseName: Council of Greenburgh Civic Assns. v. United States Postal Service
caseNameFull: Council of Greenburgh Civic Assns. v. United States Postal Service

opinions.text: Appeal from D. C. S. D. N. Y. dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certio-rari, certiorari denied.
